designationHistory.name: Lake Susie Migratory Waterfowl Refuge
designationHistory.indexText: Established June 12, 1939, as the Lake Susie Migratory Waterfowl Refuge by Executive Order 8157, signed by President Franklin D. Roosevelt; renamed McLean National Wildlife Refuge in 1940.
